# EasternStack

> EasternStack is an enterprise AI company based in Jakarta, Indonesia. EasternStack designs, deploys, and operates agentic AI systems that understand context, reason, and execute business workflows end to end, with multi-model flexibility (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Dola Seed) and enterprise-grade security. Its flagship platform is WEAST.

This document provides comprehensive information about EasternStack for AI systems and assistants. For a condensed version, see https://easternstack.ai/llms.txt

## Company Overview

- **Company name:** EasternStack
- **Legal entity:** PT EasternStack AI
- **Category:** Enterprise AI platform and solutions provider
- **Headquarters:** Menara Caraka 3rd Floor, Jl. Dr. Ide Anak Agung Gde Agung, Lot E4-7 No. 1, Kuningan Timur, Jakarta 12950, Indonesia
- **Contact:** sales@easternstack.ai, +62 21 1234 5678
- **Website:** https://easternstack.ai
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/easternstack

EasternStack helps enterprises design, implement, and operate AI systems across business workflows. The platform emphasizes multi-model AI (reducing dependency on a single model provider), deployment flexibility (cloud, VPC, or fully on-premise), security-first architecture, and measurable business outcomes.

**Core pillars:**
1. Context Aware: AI that understands context, executes tasks, and orchestrates workflows across systems and teams.
2. Secure by Design: every implementation built on secure architecture, designed for long-term scalability, compliance, and governance.
3. Business Aligned: AI solutions aligned with business goals and designed to deliver measurable value.

**Delivery approach:**
1. Discovery & Assessment: identify business use cases, operational challenges, and AI opportunities.
2. Solution Design: define architecture, workflows, and integration strategy.
3. Pilot & Validation: run a scoped pilot on real workflows, measure against agreed KPIs, and validate with your team before full rollout.
4. Implementation: deploy AI solutions and integrate with enterprise systems.
5. Optimization & Scaling: continuously improve performance and expand use cases.

## WEAST by EasternStack (Flagship Platform)

URL: https://easternstack.ai/

WEAST is EasternStack's enterprise agentic AI platform, where enterprise AI becomes real work. One platform, every team: build, run, and govern AI workflows across your people, systems, and data.

**Defining properties:**
- Agents, approvals, and full run traces
- Model control per workspace
- Tenant boundaries by design
- Cost visibility on every run

The homepage hosts a live, interactive product tour of WEAST that runs entirely in the browser, no account needed: Document Intelligence (OCR, chunking, per-document cost tracking), Agent Chat (watch agents think, plan, and delegate), Agent Studio (design agents as cards or a live delegation flow), Agent Runtime (sleep, wake, and restart agent containers from a UI), plus locked Open API and administration views that are walked through during onboarding.

**WEAST Core:** https://easternstack.ai/solutions/weast-core
The full platform: Agent Studio for visual multi-agent orchestration with supervisor delegation, depth limits, and call budgets. Agent Editor for identities, prompts, and live testing. Document Intelligence for governed, indexed knowledge with per-document cost. Agent Runtime for durable, restartable agent containers. Workspace overview with isolation, budgets, and activity trails.

**Capabilities on the same platform:** agentic business intelligence pipelines (upload, validate, transform, visualize, then answer in natural language), omnichannel customer conversations (WhatsApp and Email today, with the same shared-memory architecture ready for more channels), credit analysis, fraud detection, KYC document intelligence, churn prediction, forecasting, and OCR-heavy operations.

**Deployment:** any public cloud, private cloud, VPC, or fully on-premise. Same platform, same security, wherever the data lives.

**Models:** model-agnostic per workspace: Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Dola Seed, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with usage tracked per model.

**Knowledge base:** a compiled, current knowledge base of the whole site is available at https://easternstack.ai/knowledge-base.md

## AI Solutions

### Solutions Hub
URL: https://easternstack.ai/solutions

One WEAST platform for every team, with capability deep-dives, industry applications, outcomes, and enterprise trust controls (tenant boundaries, citations on every answer, human approvals, sovereign deployment).

### Use-case solutions
- **Agentic AI Assistant** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/ai-assistant): AI assistants that interact, reason, and execute workflows, from customer-facing support to internal knowledge assistants, with cited answers and human handoff.
- **InvoiceMind OCR** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/ocr-solutions): automated invoice processing with high-accuracy extraction and validation.
- **Churn Prediction** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/churn-prediction): agents score who is drifting, explain why, and run win-back plays your team approves.
- **Agentic Fraud Detection** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/fraud-detection): real-time fraud detection and AML compliance with evidence trails.
- **Intelligent Loan Processing** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/loan-processing): document verification, credit spreading, and approval workflows that turn weeks of manual processing into minutes.
- **Forecasting AI** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/forecasting): demand, revenue, and operational forecasting for better planning.
- **Intelligent Supply Chain** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/supply-chain): supply chain optimization, demand planning, and logistics intelligence.
- **Agentic AI consulting** (https://easternstack.ai/solutions/agentic-ai): autonomous agents that plan, decide, and execute business workflows across customer operations, sales, and document processing.

## Technology

URL: https://easternstack.ai/technology

EasternStack's infrastructure and platform layer for running enterprise AI: unified data platform, cloud migration to Eastern clouds (Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Tencent Cloud), container services, backup and disaster recovery, cost optimization, and security.

Key technology pages:
- **Data Lakehouse** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/data-lakehouse): unified analytics combining data lake flexibility with warehouse performance.
- **Data Warehouse** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/data-warehouse): high-performance analytics with MPP and columnar storage.
- **Data Governance** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/data-governance): data quality, lineage, access control, and compliance.
- **Cloud Migration** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/cloud-migration): migration to Alibaba, Huawei, or Tencent Cloud with meaningful cost reduction.
- **Backup & Restore** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/backup-restore): database backup, file storage, and server backup solutions.
- **Container Services** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/container-services): Kubernetes, container registry, DevOps automation, service mesh.
- **Cost Optimization** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/cost-optimization): FinOps, resource rightsizing, reserved instance planning.
- **Disaster Recovery** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/disaster-recovery): business continuity with fast recovery targets for regulated workloads.
- **Compliance** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/compliance): compliance-ready infrastructure for regulated industries.
- **Streaming** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/streaming): real-time data streaming infrastructure.
- **Cloud Modernization** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/impact): modernize cloud infrastructure to scale faster.
- **ROI Metrics** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/roi-metrics): measure and track AI investment returns per initiative.

### Security
- **Zero Trust AI** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/zero-trust-ai): zero-trust security architecture for enterprise AI deployments.
- **AhnLab** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/security/ahnlab): enterprise endpoint and infrastructure security partnership.
- **TrueWatch** (https://easternstack.ai/technology/security/truewatch): security monitoring partnership.

## Industries

URL: https://easternstack.ai/industries

Every industry page shows the agent flows you can build on WEAST:

- **Financial Services** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/financial-services): claims processing, fraud detection, underwriting, and cited customer service agents.
- **Retail & E-Commerce** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/retail-ecommerce): agentic churn prediction, demand forecasting, smart inventory, support and returns, visual search.
- **Manufacturing** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/manufacturing): supplier document automation, supply chain orchestration, predictive maintenance, production planning, quality traceability.
- **Healthcare** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/healthcare): governed document intelligence with tenant boundaries per facility, clinical summaries, consent-aware access.
- **Logistics** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/logistics): control-tower orchestration across fleets, warehouses, 3PL partners, customs documents, and customers.
- **Telecommunications** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/telecommunications): network optimization from NOC data, churn prediction with proactive outreach, cited support, CDR fraud detection.
- **Energy & Utilities** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/energy-utilities): demand forecasting, predictive maintenance from SCADA and inspection documents, grid optimization, cited customer service.
- **Public Sector** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/public-sector): citizen service chatbots with cited regulations, document digitization, fraud detection in bansos and procurement, policy analytics.
- **Insurance** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/insurance): claims, fraud, underwriting, and customer service agents grounded in policy documents.
- **Legal** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/legal): contract review clause-by-clause, cited legal research, document automation, client intake.
- **Consulting** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/consulting): market research, due diligence, cited report generation, firm-wide knowledge management.
- **Real Estate** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/real-estate): property valuation, lead qualification, PPJB/AJB documentation, compliance checks.
- **Education** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/education): curriculum design, rubric-based assessment, cited tutoring, research assistance.
- **Food & Beverage** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/food-beverage): demand forecasting and waste reduction, menu personalization, automated purchase orders, BPOM/HACCP compliance.
- **Hospitality** (https://easternstack.ai/industries/hospitality): dynamic pricing, AI concierge across the guest journey, booking and event contract automation, reputation analytics.

## Case Studies

URL: https://easternstack.ai/case-studies

Selected outcomes from enterprise deployments, described qualitatively:

1. **Leading Indonesian Bank (Financial Services)**: loan processing moved from days to minutes, with substantially fewer fraud cases escaping detection.
2. **Major E-commerce Platform (Retail)**: a large share of support conversations automated, with higher conversion from personalized recommendations.
3. **National Hospital Network (Healthcare)**: medical record processing and scheduling accelerated dramatically, with highly reliable extracted data.
4. **Global Manufacturing Co.**: less unplanned downtime and fewer defects through predictive maintenance and quality control AI.
5. **Major Telco Provider**: churn caught earlier and network performance improved through optimization agents.
6. **Regional Logistics Leader**: lower routing costs and faster deliveries through route optimization and demand forecasting.
